chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Salim Abi al-Fadl, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
Nothing invalidates wudu (ablution) except what comes out from your two lower outlets with which Allah has bestowed favor upon you.

key_terms.أَنْعَمَ: bestowed favor, indicating Allah's beneficence in creating them
key_terms.الْوُضُوءَ: wudu (ablution), the ritual state of purification before acts of worship
key_terms.طَرَفَيْكَ: your two extremities, referring here to the two lower outlets
key_terms.يَنْقُضُ: invalidates or breaks a state of ritual purity

ai.seo_question: What things invalidate wudu (ablution) according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning wudu (ablution): it is invalidated only by what exits from the two lower bodily outlets. It is relevant to the jurisprudence of ritual purity and clarifies the limits of what nullifies wudu (ablution).
